research_evidence: عَتيق وَالِد عَبْد الرَّحْمَن بْن عَتيق يروي عَن عَائِشَة روى عَنهُ ابْنه عَبْد الرَّحْمَن بْن عَتيق
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat (vol. 5, p. 287, Tabi'in section, shamela) says al-'Ajjaj ibn Ru'ba narrated from Abu Hurayra and that his son Ru'ba ibn al-'Ajjaj narrated from him.
research_evidence: العجاج بْن رؤبة يَرْوِي عَن أَبِي هُرَيْرَة رَوَى عَنْهُ ابْنه رؤبة بْن العجاج
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat (vol. 5, p. 288, Tabi'in section, shamela) says 'Ukaz al-Taymi narrated from Anas ibn Malik and that Harun ibn Musa narrated from him.
research_evidence: عكاظ التَّيْمِيّ يَرْوِي عَن أنس بْن مَالك رَوَى عَنْهُ هَارُون بْن مُوسَى
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat (vol. 5, p. 288, Tabi'in section, shamela) says 'Amra bint al-Shafi' narrated from Umm Salama and that 'Ammar al-Duhni narrated from her.
research_evidence: عمْرَة بنت الشافع تَرْوِي عَن أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ رَوَى عَنهُ عمار الدهني
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat (vol. 5, p. 288, Tabi'in section, shamela) says 'Amra, freedwoman of Hamna bint Shuja', narrated from Umm Qays bint Mihsan. No student is named and the page gives no kunya.
research_evidence: عمْرَة مولاة حمْنَة بنت شُجَاع تَرْوِي عَن أم قَيْس بنت مُحصن
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عزة بنت أبي قرصافة واسمه جندرة
bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat (vol. 5, p. 289, Tabi'in section, shamela) says 'Azza bint Abi Qirsafa (his name being Jandara ibn Habshiyya) narrated from her father and that the people of Palestine narrated from her.
research_teachers: Abu Qirsafa Jandara ibn Habshiyya (her father)
research_evidence: عزة بنت أَبِي قرصافة واسْمه جندرة بْن حبشية تَرْوِي عَن أَبِيهَا رَوَى عَنْهَا أهل فلسطين
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat (vol. 5, p. 290, Ghayn chapter, shamela) says Ghalib ibn 'Ajrad al-Taymi narrated from Ibn 'Umar and that Thabit al-Bunani and 'Awf al-A'rabi narrated from him.
research_evidence: غَالب بْن عجرد التَّيْمِيّ يَرْوِي عَن بن عمر رَوَى عَنْهُ ثَابت البْناني وعَوْف الْأَعرَابِي
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat (vol. 5, p. 290, Ghayn chapter, shamela) says Ghalib ibn Suwayd al-Dimashqi narrated from Abu Hurayra and that Isma'il ibn 'Ubayd Allah ibn Abi al-Muhajir narrated from him.
research_students: Isma'il ibn 'Ubayd Allah ibn Abi al-Muhajir
research_evidence: غَالب بْن سُوَيْد الدِّمَشْقِي يروي عَن أَبِي هُرَيْرَة رَوَى عَنْهُ إِسْمَاعِيل بْن عبيد اللَّه بْن أَبِي المُهَاجر
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: غيلان بن عبد الله مولى قريش
bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat (vol. 5, p. 291, Ghayn chapter, shamela) says Ghaylan ibn 'Abd Allah, client of Quraysh, narrated from Ibn 'Umar and that Shu'ba and Hushaym narrated from him.
research_evidence: غيلَان بن عبد الله مولى قُرَيْش يروي عَن بْن عمر روى عَنْهُ شُعْبَة وهشيم
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban lists him in al-Thiqat. He narrated from Ibn Umar, and Asim ibn Sulayman al-Ahwal narrated from him.
research_evidence: غَنَّام بْن قَيْس يَرْوِي عَن بن عمر روى عَنهُ عَاصِم بْن سُلَيْمَان الْأَحول
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir), Ibn Abi Hatim (al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil) and Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) list him as from Banu Mazin ibn Mansur, an ally of Banu Nawfal. He narrated from his father, and Umar ibn al-Fadl narrated from him.
research_evidence: غزوان بْن عتبة بْن غزوان من بَنِي مازن بْن مَنْصُور حليف بَنِي نوفل عَنْ أَبِيهِ روى عنه عمر بن الفضل
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban lists him in al-Thiqat. He narrated from Abu Dharr, and al-Sari ibn Yahya narrated from him.
research_evidence: غَزوَان أَبُو حَاتِم يروي عَن أَبِي ذَر روى عَنْهُ السرى بْن يحيى
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) lists him as al-Faqimi al-Tamimi, counted among the Basrans. He heard from his father, and Asim ibn Hilal narrated from him.
research_evidence: غاضرة بْن عُرْوَة الفقيمي التميمي يعد فِي الْبَصْرِيّين سَمِعَ أباه روى عَنْهُ عاصم بْن هلال
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Listed by al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir), Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) and Ibn Abi Hatim (al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil). He narrated from Umar ibn al-Khattab, and Abd Allah ibn Awn narrated from him. Ibn Abi Hatim says he is the son of Samura ibn Amr, of Banu Adi.
research_evidence: غاضرة الْعَنْبَري يروي عَن عمر بْن الْخطاب روى عَنهُ عَبْد اللَّه بْن عون
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban lists him in al-Thiqat as a shaykh. He narrated from Ibn Abbas, and Qariz ibn Shayba narrated from him.
research_evidence: غطفان شيخ يروي عَن بْن عَبَّاس روى عَنْهُ قارظ بْن شَيْبَة
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: غني بن أبي حازم الذهلي ويقال بن أ
bio: Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) says he heard from Ibn Umar and Ikrima ibn Ammar narrated from him; a chain he quotes names him 'Ghani ibn Abi Hazim al-Dhuhli'. Abu al-Fath al-Azdi gives the same teacher and student.
research_evidence: غني بْن أَبِي حازم سَمِعَ ابن عمر روى عنه عكرمة ابن عمار
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) says he saw Anas; Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) says he narrated from Anas. Sayf ibn Harun and Hushaym ibn Abi Sasan narrated from him.
research_evidence: فُضَيْل بْن كثير يَرْوِي عَن أنس رَوَى عَنْهُ سيف بْن هَارُون وهشيم بْن أَبِي ساسان

research_evidence: الْفضل بْن طَلْحَة يَرْوِي عَن جَابر بْن عَبْد الله روى عَنْهُ فرات الْقَزاز

bio: Ibn Hibban lists him in the Tabi'in section of al-Thiqat: he narrated from Anas ibn Malik and Musa ibn Ubayda narrated from him. Ibn Hibban adds that if he is al-Raqashi, the chain is not connected.
research_evidence: الْفضل بْن عِيسَى يَرْوِي عَن أنس بْن مَالك روى عَنْهُ مُوسَى بْن عُبَيْدَة

bio: Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat), Ibn Abi Hatim (al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil) and al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) give his father's name as both Ubayd and Umayr. He narrated from al-Mughira ibn Shu'ba; Abu al-Aliya and Dawud ibn Abi Hind narrated from him. Ibn Abi Hatim calls him a Basran.
research_evidence: فضَالة بْن عبيد الزهْرَانِي وَيُقَال بن عُمَيْر يَرْوِي عَن الْمُغيرَة بْن شُعْبَة رَوَى عَنْهُ أَبُو الْعَالِيَة
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: فضالة بن دينار الخزاعي كنيته أبو ح
bio: Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) gives his kunya as Abu Harb; he narrated from Ibn Umar and Makhul narrated from him. Ibn al-Athir (Usd al-Ghaba) says he lived in the Prophet's time, citing al-Bukhari.
research_evidence: فضَالة بْن دِينَار الْخُزَاعِيّ كُنْيَتُهُ أَبُو حَرْب يروي عَن بْن عمر روى عَنهُ مَكْحُول
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban lists him in al-Thiqat as narrating mursal reports (with links missing). Khulayd ibn Da'laj narrated from him.
research_evidence: فضَالة التَّمِيمِي يروي الْمَرَاسِيل رَوَى عَنْهُ خُلَيْد بْن دعْلج
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) and Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) say he heard from Ibn Umar and Abd Allah ibn Yazid ibn Dabba narrated from him. Al-Bukhari's entry notes that he was highly praised.
research_students: Abd Allah ibn Yazid ibn Dabba
research_evidence: فرقد مولى أَوْس يَرْوِي عَن بْن عمر روى عَنهُ عَبْد اللَّه بْن يزِيد بْن ضبة
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban lists him in al-Thiqat. He narrated from Anas ibn Malik, and Yusuf ibn Zayd narrated from him.
research_evidence: فرقد الْخياط يروي عَن أنس بْن مَالك رَوَى عَنْهُ يُوسُف بْن زيد
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) says he narrated from Umar ibn al-Khattab and al-Mufaddal ibn Fadala narrated from him. Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) quotes a report in which he asks Abd Allah ibn Umar about buying silk.
research_evidence: فزع بْن عفيق الْمَازِني يَرْوِي عَن عمر بْن الْخطاب روى عَنْهُ الْمفضل بْن فضَالة
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) lists him as the client (mawla) of Umar ibn al-Khattab, of Quraysh and Banu Adi. He narrated from Umar; his son Abd al-Rahman ibn Farrukh narrated from him, via Amr ibn Dinar.
research_students: his son Abd al-Rahman ibn Farrukh
research_evidence: فروخ مولى عُمَر بْن الْخَطَّاب الْقُرَشِيّ العدوي عَنْ عُمَر قَالَه عَمْرو بْن دينار عَنْ عَبْد الرَّحْمَن بْن فروخ عَنْ أَبِيه
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) and Ibn Abi Hatim (al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil) list him as a client of al-Ashtar al-Nakha'i. Ibn Abi Hatim calls him a Kufan. He narrated from Ali ibn Abi Talib; Humayd ibn Abd Allah al-Asamm narrated from him.
research_evidence: فروخ مولى الأشتر النَّخعِيّ يَرْوِي عَن عَليّ بْن أَبِي طَالب رَوَى عَنْهُ حميد بْن الْأَصَم
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir), Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) and Ibn Abi Hatim (al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil) all list him. He narrated from Ibn Abbas, and Abu Janab al-Qassab narrated from him.
research_evidence: فروخ أَبُو عنان يروي عَن بْن عَبَّاس روى عَنْهُ أَبُو جناب القصاب
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Abu al-Fath al-Azdi (in his list of narrators with unique names) says he heard from Shaddad ibn Ma'qil and Ibn Umar. Fitr ibn Khalifa and Waqa' ibn Iyas narrated from him.
research_evidence: فريس بن صعصعة سمع شداد بن معقل وابن عمر، روى عنه فطر بن خليفة ووقاء بن إياس
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat), Ibn Abi Hatim (al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil) and al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) say he narrated from Ibn Mas'ud and Abd Allah ibn Awn narrated from him. Al-Bukhari notes he met Ibn Mas'ud and quotes his report that Ibn Mas'ud disliked praying in a mosque with filth on its qibla wall.
research_evidence: فطير يروي عَن بْنِ مَسْعُود روى عَنْهُ عبد اللَّه بْن عون
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban lists him in the Tabi'in section of al-Thiqat as one of the people of Yemen who narrated from Ya'la ibn Umayya.
research_evidence: فنك من أهل الْيمن يَرْوِي عَن يعلى بن أُميَّة

bio: Listed by Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat), al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) and Ibn Abi Hatim (al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil). He narrated from Ya'la ibn Umayya and from an unnamed Companion. Ibn Abi Hatim says Wahb ibn Munabbih narrated from him; al-Azdi mentions his report on planting walnut trees.
research_evidence: فنج شيخ يَرْوِي عَن يعلى بْن أُميَّة وَعَن رجل من أَصْحَاب النَّبِيّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban lists her in al-Thiqat. She narrated from Aisha, and Mayyah ibn Sari' narrated from her. He quotes her report that Aisha pointed out a green jar as the hantam the Prophet forbade using for making nabidh.
research_evidence: فُكَيْهَةُ بِنْتُ كِلابٍ الْمُحَارِبِيَّةُ تروى عَن عَائِشَة روى عَنْهَا مَيَّاحُ بْنُ سَرِيعٍ
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: القاسم بن عبد الله بن عمرو بن الع
bio: Ibn Hibban lists him in the Tabi'in section of al-Thiqat. He narrated from his father, Abd Allah ibn Amr ibn al-As, and his son Yahya ibn al-Qasim narrated from him.
research_teachers: his father Abd Allah ibn Amr ibn al-As
research_evidence: الْقَاسِم بْن عَبْد اللَّه بْن عَمْرو بْن الْعَاصِ يروي عَن أَبِيه روى عَنهُ ابْنه يحيى بْن الْقَاسِم

bio: Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat), Ibn Abi Hatim (al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil) and al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) say he narrated from Abd Allah ibn Mughaffal and Qatada narrated from him.
research_evidence: الْقَاسِم بْن الرّبيع يَرْوِي عَن عَبْد اللَّه بْن مُغفل رَوَى عَنْهُ قَتَادَة
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: القاسم بن صفوان بن مخرمة الزهري
bio: Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) counts him among the Kufans. Ibn Abi Hatim (al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil) says he narrated from his father, who was a Companion; Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) says he narrated from Ibn Umar. Al-Sha'bi, Bashir ibn Salman and Ash'ath narrated from him.
research_evidence: القاسم بْن صفوان بْن مخرمة الزُّهْرِيّ عَنْ أَبِيه روى عنه الشَّعْبِيّ وبشير بْن سلمان وأشعث يعد فِي الكوفِيين
